stem.en: To serve orange juice, you mix two tablespoons of concentrate with water in a glass and make 150 mL of juice. Each tablespoon measures 15 mL. What is the % v/v of concentrate in the juice?

explanation.en: Two tablespoons hold 2 × 15 mL = 30 mL of concentrate. The total volume is the 150 mL of juice, so % v/v = (30 ÷ 150) × 100 = 20 %. If you got 25 %, you divided by 120 mL, the water alone. A percentage is always out of the whole solution.

hints.en: How many millilitres of concentrate are in two tablespoons?
Divide by the volume of the whole juice, then multiply by 100.
